name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: ON-SEND-ERROR-TRIGGER BUILD, not for production: every prior trigger on this branch ran cleanup proactively (every window-open or every send), disrupting reading even when nothing needed cleaning. This build runs cleanup only reactively, via browser.compose.onAfterSend, when a send actually just failed (sendInfo.error set) -- cutting how often the reading-disruption side effect happens down to only when there's a real problem, at the cost of not being able to fix the send that just failed (the user retries after cleanup finishes).
